jobs.title: Director, Global Network Services, Deloitte Global Technology
jobs.description:
**Job Type:** Permanent  

**Work Model:** Remote  

**Reference code:** 135844  

**Primary Location:** Toronto, ON  

**All Available Locations:** Toronto, ON; Edmonton, AB; Ottawa, ON

  

**Our Purpose**

  

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian\-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

  

  

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.


* Have many careers in one Firm.
* Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well\-being and connectedness.
* Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching
The intended structure of this role is a non\-relocation secondment. By nature of this structure, existing employees will remain aligned to their current location, level, service line/business area, salary, and compensation/performance review cycle, for the duration of their secondment to Deloitte Global.

  

The Director, Global Hosting Services, defines, leads, and governs Deloitte Global’s private\-cloud hosting strategy, data center and cloud networking services, and Global Wide Area Network (GWAN). The role oversees secure, resilient connectivity among Deloitte Global hosting facilities, member\-firm environments, and cloud service provider (CSP) hubs across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud. The Director also leads CSP cost reporting and invoice reconciliation through the Deloitte Cloud Services (DCS) Cloud Business Office, supports agile delivery of platform and network enhancements, and ensures operational excellence and rapid incident response across these services.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Deloitte Cloud Services (DCS) Networking**


* Oversee the design and implementation of network architecture supporting DCS hubs, connectivity among Deloitte environments, the internet, and cloud service providers, and secure access to cloud\-hosted services, including firewalls and load balancers:
	+ Multi\-CSP connectivity
	+ Inter\-CSP connectivity
	+ Secure hybrid\-cloud IPv4/IPv6 connectivity
	+ CSP inter\-region global connectivity
	+ CSP intra\-region scalability
	+ IP addressing management
* Lead the team in delivering these services, with operational excellence and 24/7 monitoring and support.
* Drive continuous improvement and automation through API enhancements and agentic AI solutions to reduce service\-delivery time and enable proactive monitoring, rapid issue identification, and resolution.
**What will your typical day look like?**
-----------------------------------------


**Interfirm Network Service (GWAN)**


* Lead the Interfirm Network Service (INS), providing seamless, secure, resilient, and optimized connectivity among member firms and across public\-cloud environments.
* Develop solution roadmaps and architectures that address evolving business needs, technology requirements, cybersecurity threats, and demand for high\-performance, low\-latency connectivity.
* Drive operational service excellence, support member\-firm disaster recovery testing exercises, and adapt connectivity options as firms implement local in\-country WAN and SD\-WAN solutions.
* Manage IPv4/IPv6 address allocation for member firms and countries.
  

**Deloitte Cloud Services (DCS) Cloud Business Office**


* Provide scaled agile delivery services supporting product enhancements for DCS platform, product, and networking teams, as well as Global Enterprise Cloud Management Services.
* Lead Cloud Business Office delivery of CSP cost insights for member firms, CSP invoice reconciliation, and billing to Deloitte entities. Support FinOps through cost\-optimization recommendations, CSP cost reporting, and AI token\-ledger reporting.
  

**Risk Management \& Compliance**


* Ensure all data center and cloud\-platform solutions comply with global regulatory, security, and privacy standards.
* Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Serve as a trusted liaison to Cyber teams on cloud\-related matters, champion Cyber initiatives, and review and provide feedback on Cyber standards and programs.
  

**Private Cloud Delivery (Colocation Services)**


* Define and continuously evolve Deloitte Global’s private\-hosting and colocation strategy, including regional services in the United States and Germany. Adapt the strategy to emerging requirements such as zero\-trust networking, private infrastructure supporting GPU\-intensive AI workloads, and future quantum\-computing capabilities.
* Lead the team in delivering these services while maintaining operational excellence and compliance with audit, SOC, and ISO requirements.
* Develop private\-cloud roadmaps, standards, and reference architectures, and establish governance frameworks, policies, and cost\-recovery processes.
**About the team**
------------------


Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in what is but rather what can be to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.


**Enough about us, let’s talk about you**
-----------------------------------------


* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field.
* 15 or more years

jobs.title: Director AI Enablement
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**The Director, AI Enablement is accountable for establishing and advancing Chartwell’s enterprise AI practice. The role exists to help the organization adopt AI safely, practically and at scale by combining strong governance with education, advisory support, and pragmatic implementation guidance.


This is not a pure research or data science leadership role. The Director, AI Enablement governs how AI is introduced into day\-to\-day work, helps departments identify and prioritize valuable AI use cases, and ensures that AI systems are deployed responsibly as they become more multimodal, more connected to enterprise data, and more capable of influencing decisions, workflows, and user behaviour.


The role serves as the organization’s AI expertise\-as\-a\-service function, working across corporate departments, FASTech, Service Management \& Automation, Business Analysis \& Quality Assurance, Data \& Analytics, Privacy, Cybersecurity, and enterprise applications to ensure that AI\-enabled solutions are useful, explainable, governable, and aligned to Chartwell’s operational realities.


**Key Accountabilities*****Enterprise AI Governance***

* Develop, maintain, and evolve Chartwell’s AI governance framework, standards, guardrails, and acceptable\-use practices in alignment with legal, privacy, security, and risk requirements.
* Define practical controls for responsible AI use, including human accountability, override mechanisms, confidence thresholds, auditability, data handling expectations, and documentation standards.
* Lead AI intake and review processes to assess proposed use cases for appropriateness, value, risk, explainability, and organizational readiness.
* Establish approval paths and risk classification for AI initiatives, distinguishing between low\-risk productivity uses, operational decision support, and higher\-risk use cases.
* Partner with Privacy, Cybersecurity, Legal, and enterprise technology leaders to ensure AI\-enabled solutions meet policy, compliance, and audit expectations.

***AI Education and Organizational Readiness***

* Design and deliver role\-based AI education, awareness, and training programs for leaders, practitioners, and end users.
* Create and maintain practical playbooks, templates, examples, and decision guides that help teams use AI effectively and responsibly.
* Promote AI literacy across the organization by translating technical concepts into plain\-language guidance and actionable practices.
* Support leaders in understanding the opportunities and risks of multimodal AI, connected AI, agentic workflows, and AI\-assisted decision support.
* Track adoption, usage patterns, and learning outcomes to refine enablement programs and improve organizational readiness.

***AI Expertise\-as\-a\-Service***

* Provide advisory support to all corporate departments on AI opportunities, use\-case framing, vendor/tool evaluation, and solution options.
* Help teams convert ambiguous problems into clear AI and automation use cases with defined objectives, constraints, risks, and success measures.
* Support business and technology teams during design and implementation by providing practical guidance on model and tool selection, workflow design, prompting patterns, and integration considerations.
* Act as a trusted internal partner who helps departments move from experimentation to controlled, business\-aligned AI adoption.
* Contribute expert guidance to FASTech and other delivery teams so AI\-enabled solutions remain practical, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.

***Safeguarding the Organization as AI Evolves***

* Develop guidance and control patterns for AI systems that use text, images, documents, screenshots, voice, and other multimodal inputs or outputs.
* Establish governance for AI systems that are connected to enterprise data sources, documents, communications, applications, and external research tools.
* Assess and mitigate risks related to hallucinations, model drift, privacy invasion, data leakage, bias, impersonation, surveillance, over\-reliance, and unsafe automation.
* Define boundaries for where AI may assist versus where decisions must remain deterministic or human\-owned, especially for safety, compliance, financial approvals, and resident\-impacting decisions.
* Provide guidance on the safe use of AI as an assistant, coach, or decision\-support tool, including controls to prevent manipulation, inappropriate inference, or hidden monitoring behaviours.

***Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Reporting***

* Work closely with FASTech, Service Management \& Automation, Business Analysis \& Quality Assurance, Data \& Analytics, Cybersecurity, enterprise applications, and business leaders to align AI adoption with business priorities.
* Maintain visibility into approved AI use cases, tools, integrations, risks, and realized outcomes across the organization.
* Contribute to executive reporting on AI pipeline, enablement activities, governance findings, adoption levels, and realized value.
* Identify recurring themes, risks, and opportunities across departments and recommend pragmatic improvements to Chartwell’s AI operating model.

**Qualifications*****Education:***

* University degree in Computer Science, Data, Information Systems, Business, Risk, Privacy, or a related discipline; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* As an alternative to a Computer Science or Data\-focused degree, demonstrated and credible expertise in AI Governance, responsible AI, and enterprise AI enablement will be considered.
* Relevant coursework, certifications, or professional development in AI governance, privacy, risk, responsible AI, or change management are assets.

***Experience:***

* Progressive experience in AI enablement, AI governance, technology advisory, digital transformation, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience establishing governance, standards, or policy controls for enterprise technology or AI ad

jobs.title: Global Head of Architecture
jobs.description:
**Build the future of AI and data with us**
-------------------------------------------


Datatonic is a leading Google Cloud partner specialising in data and AI. We help organisations design, build and operate production AI systems, from governed data foundations and machine learning platforms to generative AI applications and agentic workflows. Our teams combine Google Cloud, software engineering, machine learning, data engineering and analytics expertise with the consulting skills needed to turn complex business requirements into reliable products.

  

**Your mission**
----------------


As Architecture Lead, you will be a hands\-on Cloud Architect who also leads Datatonic's team of architects. You will design and build cloud, data and application estates yourself, while setting the standards, growing the people and owning the quality of architecture across our client work.


You will split your time between three things: delivering architecture on our most complex engagements, leading and developing a team of architects, and representing Datatonic as a technical authority with clients and in pre\-sales.

 **What you'll do**

  

### **Hands\-on architecture**

* **Target architecture:** Design and lead target architectures across cloud, data and application estates on Google Cloud, covering the platforms and the systems that run on them.
* **Hands\-on build:** Stay close to the code. Prototype, write infrastructure as code, review pull requests and unblock engineering teams on hard technical problems.
* **Systems design:** Own boundaries, failure modes, security, cost, operability and how each design evolves over time.
* **Trade\-off ownership:** Resolve architectural trade\-offs across Platform, Data, Analytics, AI, Software and UX.
* **Delivery governance:** Act as design authority on our most complex engagements, making sure what we ship is secure, reliable and maintainable.

  

### **Leading the architecture team**

* **People leadership:** Line manage and develop a team of architects, including career conversations, performance reviews and growth plans.
* **Mentorship:** Coach architects and discipline leads while leaving delivery ownership with them.
* **Standards and patterns:** Set architecture standards, reference patterns and decision\-record practices used across projects and regions.
* **Capability building:** Grow architecture capability through hiring, training, communities of practice and design reviews.
* **Staffing:** Work with delivery leadership to match architects to engagements.

  

### **Clients and market**

* **Pre\-sales:** Shape solution architecture, estimates and proposals, especially where estate design carries the risk.
* **Client leadership:** Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, from engineering leads to CTOs.
* **Thought leadership:** Help shape service propositions and represent Datatonic as a technical authority at events and with Google Cloud.

  

### **Working with agents**


You will use agents throughout engineering delivery and maintain the agents that support the architecture discipline, including their versioning, evaluation, operation and continuous improvement. This covers agents for option analysis, decision\-record drafts, consistency checks against established patterns, and initial threat and cost assessments.

 **What you'll bring**

* **Cloud architecture depth:** Extensive hands\-on experience designing and building production systems on Google Cloud (or AWS/Azure with a strong interest in GCP).
* **Engineering foundation:** Proven depth in at least one engineering discipline (platform, data, software or ML engineering) at Senior 2 / L5 or above.
* **Demonstrated breadth:** Evidence of systems design across disciplines, including networking, security, IAM, data platforms and application architecture.
* **Hands\-on skills:** Comfortable with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, and at least one programming language such as Python.
* **Team leadership:** Experience leading, mentoring or line managing engineers or architects, and raising the bar for a whole team.
* **Client leadership:** Client\-facing architecture leadership with senior stakeholders, including pre\-sales and solution shaping.
* **Communication:** Ability to explain complex trade\-offs clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, in writing and in person.

  

### **Bonus points if you have**

* **Google Cloud certifications:** Professional Cloud Architect or similar.
* **Complex estates:** Experience with multi\-cloud, hybrid or complex integration environments.
* **Architecture methods:** Experience applying formal architecture methods (e.g. TOGAF) in complex delivery environments.
* **AI and data platforms:** Experience architecting ML platforms, generative AI applications or agentic systems in production.
* **Consultancy background:** Experience in a consultancy or professional services environment.

 **What's in it for you?**


We believe in empowering our team to thrive, with benefits including:

* **20 days** of **paid vacation** per calendar year
* **Public Holidays** for your Province of Residence
* **5 Wellness days** (sickness, personal time, mental health)
* **5 Lifestyle days** (religious events, volunteer day, sick day)
* **Matching Group Retirement Savings Plan** after 3 months
* Competitive **Group Insurance plan** on Day 1 \- individual premium paid 100%!
* **Virtual Medicine** and **Family Assistance Program \-** 100% employer\-paid!
* **Home office budget** \- We are 100% remote!


	+ CAD $70/month for internet/phone expenses
	+ Company\-supplied MacBook Pro or Air
* **CAD $400/year** for books, relevant app subscriptions or an e\-reader.
* Opportunities for **paid certifications**
* Opportunities for professional and personal learning through **Udemy Business**
* Regular company **off\-sites and meetups**

  

**Why Datatonic?**
------------------


Datatonic is a UK\-based compan
